title: Niadra Context Pack v1
description: What an agent should know about one subject now: text for the model and metadata for the program. See spec/context-pack.md.

breakpoints.description: Character offsets where a cache breakpoint may be placed.
breakpoints.title: Breakpoints

salt.description: Stable cache salt for self-hosted engines.
salt.title: Salt

ContextPack.description: The pack as data (`format: "json"`): the same bytes as `text`, split by section in layer order.

spec.description: The shape's version. `context-pack.v1` adds `slots` to `v0` and changes nothing else.
spec.title: Spec

preamble.description: The tenant block: the line that says the content is data, not instructions, and the usage rules.
preamble.title: Preamble

slots.description: Memory v2: the lines of `slots`, typed. Not part of the pinned sections.
slots.title: Slots

ContextPack.title: ContextPack

DeliveryPath.description: Which read tier answered a `context()` call.
DeliveryPath.title: DeliveryPath

LiveTurn.description: A recent turn from another conversation, not yet absorbed by the pack (B3). It passes the same policy as the pack's items: the level the conversation proved and the reader's purposes decide.
LiveTurn.title: LiveTurn

PackGuard.description: What one guard line states: the value memory holds for a kind the turn asked about, by the precedence of who stated it, so the agent's answer can be checked against it at once.

id.description: The value's short id, as the guard line's `PackSlot.id`.
id.title: Id

value.description: The value as the line writes it.
value.title: Value

PackGuard.title: PackGuard

name.description: Stable across languages; read this, never `label`.
name.title: Name

label.description: The line's label in the space's language, as the text shows it.
label.title: Label

PackSlot.description: One line of the per-turn slots (memory v2): an item the customer's last turn selected, a guard (a value the agent must not state otherwise), or a line derived from memory (`count`, `no_record`, `withheld`).

section.description: The pack section the item comes from (`episodes`, `objects`...), `guard` for a guard line, or `derived`.
section.title: Section

id.description: The short id of the item the line states: the last eight hex digits of its public id. An agent's turn names a guard it went against by it. Absent for a derived line.
id.title: Id

channels.description: The channels that ranked the item: `exact`, `lexical`, `temporal`, `values`, `semantic`, `linked`.
channels.title: Channels

why.description: With `explain`: why this line was chosen.

PackSlot.title: PackSlot

PackStamp.description: What an agent's turn should carry to say which pack its prompt held (spec 8.5).
PackStamp.title: PackStamp

SlotChannelRank.description: One retrieval channel's part in a slot's fused score (weighted reciprocal rank fusion).

position.description: 1-based, in that channel's own ranking for the turn.
position.title: Position

weight.description: The channel's weight in this fusion.
weight.title: Weight

contribution.description: `weight / (60 + position)`: what the channel added to `score`.
contribution.title: Contribution

SlotChannelRank.title: SlotChannelRank

SlotWhy.description: Why a line took a slot (`explain`). Ids, positions and numbers; never a line or a value.

item_id.description: The item, as manifests and context-use name it; absent for a derived line.
item_id.title: Item Id

score.description: The fused score: the sum of the channels' contributions.
score.title: Score

channels.description: Each channel that ranked the item, in fusion order.
channels.title: Channels

weights_version.description: The space's learned fusion weights used; absent for the defaults.
weights_version.title: Weights Version

via.description: For an item the `linked` channel brought: the exact match it is tied to, as `item_id`.
via.title: Via

excerpt.description: The line was cut to the sentences that answer the turn.
excerpt.title: Excerpt

rule.description: For a derived line: `guard_<value type>` (a guard line), `count_complaints`, `count_conversations`, `no_record` or `withheld_may_hold`.
rule.title: Rule

basis.description: For a derived line, what the rule counted or missed: `basis` (the conversation that chose the category, or the value a guard states), `category`, `counted`, `window_days`; `asked_types`, `identifiers` (how many numbers the turn named, never which), `withheld`; for a guard, `value_type` and `origin` (who stated the value).
basis.title: Basis

SlotWhy.title: SlotWhy

status.description: `ok` or `silent` when the source stopped sending.
status.title: Status

Verification.description: Session verification levels. `no_customer` sits outside the V0-V4 scale.
Verification.title: Verification

reason.description: Why effective is lower: `source_ceiling`, `not_proven`, or `unconfirmed_link` (the read went through an identifier joined to the profile by a claim nobody confirmed yet, so it stays at V1 until the company's systems, a login or a person confirm the link).
reason.title: Reason

withheld.description: Items and `live` turns the policy left out for this reader and level.
withheld.title: Withheld

live.description: Recent turns of the customer's other conversations not yet in the compiled context, oldest first: at most the newest 50, from the newest 100 turns of each of the customer's handles.
live.title: Live

live_complete.description: False when the hot layer was unavailable, a turn could not be read, or a handle had more recent turns than were read.
live_complete.title: Live Complete

delta.description: With `delta`: what memory learned since this agent's last read, for the end of the prompt. The turn block after `text` is `live`, then `slots`, then `delta`.
delta.title: Delta

slots.description: Memory v2, with `query`: what the customer's last turn selected from memory for this turn. It goes in the turn block after `text`, in this order: the `live` turns, then `slots`, then `delta`. Never part of `text`, which stays the same bytes for the whole conversation.
slots.title: Slots

guards.description: Memory v2: what the guard lines among `slots` state, typed. An SDK checks the agent's answer against them and names a guard the answer went against on the agent's turn (`backing.guard_violations`).
guards.title: Guards
